components.name: Accordion
components.text: Accordion is a vertically stacked set of collapsible sections with clickable triggers that toggle content panels. It supports type='single' where only one section can be open at a time (like a filing cabinet) and type='multiple' where several sections expand simultaneously. Use it for FAQs, settings panels, sidebar navigation, and content-heavy pages where space management matters. Features smooth CSS animations, keyboard navigation with arrow keys based on orientation, persistent state via localStorage with storageKey, and WCAG-compliant ARIA roles including role='region' on content panels. Variants include default, bordered, separated, and flush styles. Supports sizes sm, md, and lg, horizontal and vertical orientation, and proper heading hierarchy with configurable h1-h6 elements. States: expanded, collapsed, disabled. Accessible via Enter, Space, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home, End keys.

components.name: Avatar
components.text: Avatar displays a user representation as an image, initials, or custom fallback content with optional status indicators, badges, and shimmer loading. The fallback hierarchy is: Image → Fallback ReactNode → Auto-generated initials from name → Empty circle. Use it for user profiles, comment sections, team lists, and chat interfaces. Supports grouping via AvatarGroup with configurable overlap spacing and '+N' overflow counting. Features include autoColor for deterministic color generation from names with dark mode support via CSS custom properties, tooltips, count badges, custom shapes (circle, square, rounded), and sizes from xs to xl or custom pixel values. Status indicators show online, offline, away, or busy states. Image loading is lazy by default with onLoad/onError callbacks. Accessibility: role='img' with aria-label, proper alt text handling. States: idle, loading, loaded, error.

components.name: BrandLogo
components.text: BrandLogo renders the Chumlab brand identity in three presentational variants: LogoMark (icon image only), LogoWordmark (styled text only), and LogoFull (icon plus text combined). Use it in headers, footers, navigation bars, splash screens, and loading states for consistent brand representation. Each variant is a separate exportable component. Supports custom sizes and className overrides. Not interactive by design — wrap in Link or Button if clickable behavior is needed. Accessibility: semantic image and text rendering.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.text: Breadcrumb provides a navigation trail showing the user's current location within a site hierarchy. It automatically collapses intermediate items into an ellipsis dropdown when the trail exceeds maxVisibleItems, keeping the first and last items always visible. Use it for multi-level website navigation, file browsers, e-commerce category paths, and any hierarchical location display. The last item is automatically styled as the active/current page. Supports custom separators (string or ReactNode), tooltips on items, disabled items, icons, and full keyboard navigation through the collapsed dropdown. Accessibility: nav landmark with aria-label='Breadcrumb', aria-current='page' on last item, ordered list structure with proper li nesting, presentation separators. Keyboard: Enter, Space, ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Escape for dropdown. States: idle, dropdownOpen.

components.name: Button
components.text: Button is a polymorphic, accessible action trigger that can render as a native button, anchor link, span, or any custom element via the asChild composition pattern. It provides structural defaults (padding, focus ring, disabled state, transitions) while visual styling is applied via className for maximum design flexibility. Use it for form submission, navigation links, dialog triggers, destructive operations, and any clickable action. Features include loading states with spinner and aria-busy announcement, start and end icons with hover animations (slideRight, slideLeft, slideUp, slideDown, bounce, pulse, spin via group class), built-in tooltip integration, and disabled state that prevents pointer events. The component intentionally avoids built-in color variants so you own the visual design. Accessibility: native button semantics, aria-busy='true' when loading, aria-disabled='true' for disabled/loading, focus-visible ring, Space and Enter key activation. States: idle, loading, disabled, hover, focus, active.

components.name: CascadingDropdown
components.text: CascadingDropdown provides a multi-level hierarchical selection menu with nested submenus that open on hover or keyboard navigation. Each level can independently use selectionMode='single' (radio behavior) or 'multi' (checkbox behavior). Use it for category-subcategory selection, navigation menus, and tree-structured data. Supports async child loading via onLoadChildren callback, debounced search within menus and submenus, checkbox display for multi-select items, and portal rendering to escape overflow containers. Value shape is an object mapping parent values to child selections. Do not use for flat single-level selects (use Dropdown) or deeply nested structures beyond 3 levels. Accessibility: role='menu' container, role='menuitem' on parents, role='menuitemcheckbox' for multi-select, role='menuitemradio' for single-select, aria-expanded on expandable items, aria-checked states. Keyboard: Enter, Space, ArrowDown, ArrowUp, ArrowRight, ArrowLeft, Escape, Home, End. States: idle, open, closed, loading, disabled.

components.name: Checkbox
components.text: Checkbox allows users to select one or more options from a set, backed by a native input element for full form integration. Supports three visual states: checked, unchecked, and indeterminate (for 'select all' patterns where some children are selected). Works controlled (checked + onValueChange) or uncontrolled (defaultChecked). Use it for boolean form inputs, todo lists, settings, bulk selection interfaces, and terms acceptance. Features include custom sizes from xs to xl or pixel values, shapes (square or rounded), custom check and indeterminate icons, validation states with error messages, description text, and label association. Do not use for toggle switches (use Switch) or mutually exclusive choices (use RadioButton). Accessibility: native input type='checkbox' wrapped by label, data-checked/data-indeterminate/data-disabled attributes, proper label association, error message slots, reduced motion support. Keyboard: Space to toggle.

components.name: CountryFlag
components.text: CountryFlag renders country flag images as SVG from ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes (e.g., 'us', 'gb', 'in'). Use it alongside phone inputs, address forms, language selectors, internationalization features, and country-related data display. Supports preset sizes (xs through 2xl) or custom pixel values, tooltips showing country names, custom base paths for flag assets, and load/error callbacks. CountryFlagGroup enables displaying multiple flags with configurable overlap and max count showing '+N' overflow. Accessibility: role='img' with aria-label set to alt text or code, data-country attribute with ISO code, data-loaded/data-error state tracking. States: idle, loading, loaded, error.

components.name: DatePicker
components.text: DatePicker provides calendar-based date selection with three modes: single date (returns Date or null), date range (returns DateRange with start/end), and multiple dates (returns Date array). Use it for booking systems, scheduling interfaces, date filters, reporting date ranges, and form date fields. Features include preset date ranges for quick selection (Today, Last 7 days, This month, etc.), date markers with color-coded tooltips on calendar cells, disabled date configuration via function or date array, month and year dropdown navigation, multiple months side-by-side view, week number display, configurable week start day, and min/max date constraints. Supports controlled and uncontrolled usage. Calendar grid uses keyboard navigation with arrow keys for date cells, PageUp/PageDown for month navigation, Home/End for week boundaries. Accessibility: role='grid' on calendar, day state attributes (data-selected, data-today, data-in-range, data-focused), proper ARIA labels on all interactive elements. States: idle, open, closed, disabled. Dark mode fully supported with Tailwind dark: variants.

components.name: Drawer
components.text: Drawer is a sliding panel overlay that appears from any edge of the screen — left, right, top, or bottom. It renders via portal with focus trapping, scroll locking, and proper cleanup. Use it for mobile navigation menus, settings panels, detail views, form sidebars, and supplementary content that slides in contextually. Features include swipe-to-close gestures with configurable threshold and velocity, snap points for multi-position stops (e.g., 50% and 100% of screen), stacked drawer support for nesting, overlay customization, keepMounted option to preserve DOM with inert attribute, and transition lifecycle callbacks (onOpenStart, onOpenEnd, onCloseStart, onCloseEnd). Do not confuse with Modal — Drawer is spatial (slides from edge) while Modal is centered. Accessibility: role='dialog' with aria-modal, aria-label='Dialog' default, focus trapping (configurable), focus restoration on close, Escape key dismissal, scroll lock. States: open, closed, dragging.

components.name: Dropdown
components.text: Dropdown provides single-value selection from a list of options, functioning as an enhanced select element. It renders the dropdown content via portal to prevent clipping by overflow:hidden containers. Use it for forms, filters, settings, and any single-choice selection from a predefined list. Works controlled (value + onValueChange) or uncontrolled (defaultValue). Features include searchable options with keyboard type-ahead filtering, async option loading with onLoadOptions and shimmer placeholders, custom option rendering via renderOption, option grouping, disabled individual options, configurable positioning (top/bottom with auto-flip), hidden input for native form submission with name prop, and click-outside detection. Do not use for multi-select (use MultiSelectDropdown) or when native select is sufficient. Accessibility: role='listbox' on content, role='option' on items, aria-selected on active option, data-selected/data-focused/data-disabled attributes. Keyboard: Enter/Space to open/select, ArrowDown/ArrowUp to navigate, Escape to close, Home/End. States: idle, open, closed, loading, disabled.

components.name: Input
components.text: Input is a production-grade text field wrapping a native input element with comprehensive form integration. Use it for text fields, email inputs, password fields, search bars, and any single-line data entry. Features include label association, prefix and suffix text or elements (e.g., '$' prefix, '.com' suffix), start and end icon slots with optional click handlers (onStartIconClick, onEndIconClick), clearable with X button, character count display with maxLength enforcement, loading state with spinner, three size variants (sm, md, lg), validation states (error, success) with descriptive messages, and description text. Works with native form attributes and ref forwarding. Do not use for multi-line input (use TextArea), select dropdowns (use Dropdown), or rich text editing. Accessibility: associated label element via htmlFor/id, aria-describedby for description/error/success messages, data-size/data-error/data-success attributes for CSS hooks, required field marking, aria-busy during loading. States: idle, focused, disabled, error, success, loading.

components.name: InternationalPhoneInput
components.text: InternationalPhoneInput combines a country selector dropdown with a formatted phone number input field for international phone number collection. Use it in registration forms, contact forms, and any context requiring phone numbers with country codes. The value is an object with countryCode (ISO alpha-2) and phoneNumber (digits only). Features include automatic country detection from pasted international numbers, dial code display in dropdown, preferred and excluded country lists, phone number auto-formatting per country pattern, paste detection with automatic country resolution, configurable copy format (E.164, national, international), validation with error/success states, and hidden form inputs for native submission ({name} and {name}_country). Supports controlled and uncontrolled modes. Accessibility: data-* attributes for states (disabled, error, success, readonly, loading), label auto-associated via htmlFor, keyboard navigation through country dropdown with arrow keys. States: idle, focused, dropdownOpen, disabled, error.

components.name: Loader
components.text: Loader displays animated loading indicators in four variants: CircularLoader (spinning ring with optional progress), LinearLoader (horizontal progress bar with determinate/indeterminate modes), DotLoader (bouncing dots animation), and PulseLoader (pulsing ring effect). Use it for page loading states, button loading indicators, content placeholders, data fetching feedback, and skeleton screens. Each variant is a separate component with customizable size, color, speed, and accessible label. CircularLoader supports progress percentage display. LinearLoader supports determinate progress (0-100) or indeterminate animation. All animations respect prefers-reduced-motion media query. Accessibility: all variants use role='status' with aria-live='polite' and aria-label='Loading' for screen reader announcements. States: loading.

components.name: Modal
components.text: Modal displays content in an accessible dialog overlay that appears centered on screen with a backdrop, requiring user interaction before returning to main content. Use it for confirmation dialogs, form overlays, alerts, detail views, and any content requiring focused attention. Features include automatic focus trapping that cycles through focusable elements with Tab/Shift+Tab, scroll locking on document body, overlay click dismissal (configurable via closeOnOverlayClick), Escape key dismissal (configurable), size variants for content width, custom header with icon and title/description, smooth enter/exit CSS animations, and support for nested modals up to 5 levels with proper z-index stacking. Supports keepMounted to preserve DOM with inert. Accessibility: role='dialog' on content, aria-modal='true', data-open/data-nesting-level/data-reduce-motion attributes, focus trapping enabled by default, Escape key support, focus restoration to previously focused element on close. States: open, closed.

components.name: MultiSelectDropdown
components.text: MultiSelectDropdown allows users to select multiple values from a dropdown list, displaying selected items as removable chips in the trigger area. Use it for tag selection, filter panels, multi-category assignment, and any context where users need to pick several options from a list. Features include checkbox indicators on each option, configurable maxDisplayedChips with '+N more' overflow badge, async option loading with shimmer placeholders, custom trigger rendering, portal-based positioning to escape overflow containers, disabled individual options, and keyboard navigation. Selected chips have accessible remove buttons (native button elements with tabIndex=0). Works controlled (value + onValueChange) or uncontrolled (defaultValue). Do not use for single selection (use Dropdown or SearchableDropdown). Accessibility: role='combobox' on trigger, role='listbox' on options, data-* attributes for states, label auto-associated. Keyboard: Enter/Space to toggle selection, ArrowDown/ArrowUp to navigate, Escape to close. States: idle, open, closed, loading, disabled.

components.name: MultiSelectSearchableDropdown
components.text: MultiSelectSearchableDropdown extends MultiSelectDropdown with an integrated search input for filtering and finding options in large lists. Use it when the option list is large and users need to search before selecting multiple items. Features include debounced search with configurable delay (searchDebounce), async search via onSearch callback that replaces local filtering, initial options prefetch, chip display for selected values with keyboard-accessible remove buttons, and all features of MultiSelectDropdown. Local filtering is used by default; providing onSearch switches to async mode where the parent controls the options array based on search results. Accessibility: search input with aria-label, role='combobox' on trigger, role='listbox' on options, data-position shows dropdown direction. Keyboard: Enter/Space to toggle, ArrowDown/ArrowUp to navigate, Escape to close, Backspace in search. States: idle, open, closed, loading, searching, disabled.

components.name: OtpInput
components.text: OtpInput provides a series of individual character input fields for entering one-time passwords and verification codes. Each character gets its own input box with automatic focus advancement. Use it for two-factor authentication, email verification codes, phone confirmation, PIN entry, and any OTP workflow. Default length is 6 characters. Features include configurable length (1-12), visual grouping with separators (e.g., 3-3 split via grouping prop), alphanumeric or numeric-only modes, paste support that distributes characters across all inputs simultaneously, auto-submit on completion via onComplete callback, auto-focus on mount, and validation states with error/success messages. Works controlled (value + onValueChange) or uncontrolled (defaultValue). Responsive sizing with w-10 h-10 on mobile and w-12 h-12 on larger screens. Accessibility: each input has aria-label='Digit N of M', aria-invalid on error, full keyboard navigation (ArrowLeft/ArrowRight between fields, Backspace/Delete, Home/End). States: idle, focused, complete, disabled, error.

components.name: Pagination
components.text: Pagination provides page navigation controls for paginated content with configurable layout sections. Use it for data tables, search results, product listings, and any paginated data display. Features include configurable siblingCount controlling visible page numbers around current page, rows-per-page selector dropdown with customizable options, custom ellipsis rendering, custom page info rendering (e.g., 'Showing 1-10 of 100'), section ordering to rearrange navigation layout, previous/next icon customization, and accessible live region that announces page changes to screen readers. Works controlled (currentPage + onPageChange) or uncontrolled (defaultCurrentPage). Accessibility: aria-current='page' on active button, aria-expanded on dropdown, data-disabled on boundary buttons, data-active on current page, role='navigation' landmark, screen reader status announcements. Keyboard: Enter/Space on buttons, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight navigation. States: idle, disabled.

components.name: RadioButton
components.text: RadioButton allows users to select exactly one option from a group of mutually exclusive choices using native radio input elements. Use it for settings, surveys, forms, payment method selection, and any single-choice scenario. RadioGroup wrapper manages group state and layout. Features include size presets from xs to xl, horizontal and vertical orientation, custom checked/unchecked icons, validation with error messages, description text per option, and disabled individual options or entire group. Uses native input type='radio' so the browser handles arrow key navigation within the group automatically. Works controlled (value + onValueChange on RadioGroup) or uncontrolled (defaultValue). Do not use for multi-select (use Checkbox) or toggle switches (use Switch). Accessibility: role='radiogroup' on wrapper with aria-label, native radio inputs with associated labels via htmlFor/id, aria-invalid and aria-describedby for errors, focus-visible ring. Keyboard: ArrowUp/ArrowDown/ArrowLeft/ArrowRight to navigate options. States: checked, unchecked, disabled.

components.name: ResizablePanel
components.text: ResizablePanel creates resizable split layouts with draggable dividers between content panels. Use it for code editor layouts, file explorer sidebars, dashboard panel arrangements, comparison views, and any interface where users need to adjust panel proportions. Supports horizontal (left-right) and vertical (top-bottom) split directions. Features include configurable min and max size constraints per panel (in percentages), resize callback reporting new sizes, keyboard-accessible drag handles with arrow key resizing and Home/End for min/max jumps, Escape to cancel active resize, disabled state, and custom styling for panels and handles. Accessibility: role='separator' on drag handle, aria-valuenow/aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax for current size, aria-orientation for direction, tabIndex=0 on handle for keyboard focus. Keyboard: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight or ArrowUp/ArrowDown to resize, Home/End for min/max, Escape to cancel. States: idle, resizing, disabled.

components.name: SearchableDropdown
components.text: SearchableDropdown is a single-select dropdown with an integrated search input for filtering and finding options in large lists. It renders via portal to prevent clipping. Use it when the option list is large and users need to search by name or label before selecting. Local string filtering is used by default; providing onSearch switches to async mode where options are controlled by the parent based on search results. Features include debounced async search, shimmer loading state during async operations, custom option rendering via renderOption, option grouping, portal-based positioning with auto-flip, hidden input for native form submission, and click-outside detection. Do not use for multi-select (use MultiSelectSearchableDropdown) or when search is unnecessary (use Dropdown). Accessibility: role='combobox' on trigger, role='listbox' on options, search input with aria-label, data-disabled/data-error/data-open/data-success attributes, label auto-associated. Keyboard: Enter to select, ArrowDown/ArrowUp to navigate, Escape to close, Home/End. States: idle, open, closed, loading, searching, disabled.

components.name: Slider
components.text: Slider allows users to select a value or range from a continuous or stepped scale by dragging a thumb along a track. Supports single-thumb mode for one value and dual-thumb mode for range selection (min-max). Use it for price range filters, volume controls, brightness settings, opacity adjustments, and any numeric input where visual feedback along a scale is helpful. Features include configurable min/max/step values, marks at specific positions with labels, tooltip display during drag with custom formatting via formatTooltip, vertical orientation, and comprehensive keyboard control. Do not use for non-numeric selections or when discrete buttons are more appropriate. Accessibility: role='slider' on thumb, aria-valuenow/aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax, aria-orientation, focus-visible ring. Keyboard: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight or ArrowUp/ArrowDown to increment/decrement, Shift+Arrow for larger steps, Home for min, End for max, PageUp/PageDown for large jumps. States: idle, dragging, disabled.

components.name: Stepper
components.text: Stepper displays progress through a sequence of numbered or labeled steps in a linear workflow. Use it for multi-step forms, wizards, checkout flows, onboarding processes, and any sequential task tracking. Features include three indicator variants (numbered, icon, dot), horizontal and vertical orientation, clickable steps for non-linear navigation with optional beforeStepChange guard function, responsive sizing that adapts between breakpoints, tooltip descriptions on steps, completion state tracking, and error state per step. Works controlled (value + onValueChange) or uncontrolled (defaultValue). Each step can have a label, description, icon, and individual disabled state. Accessibility: role='tab' on steps, aria-selected for active step, data-status (pending/active/completed/error), keyboard navigation with Enter/Space on clickable steps, loop support. States: idle, active, completed, disabled, error.

components.name: Switch
components.text: Switch is a binary toggle control for on/off settings, rendering as a native button with role='switch' and aria-checked. Use it for feature toggles, settings preferences, boolean form fields, dark mode toggles, and notification settings. Features include custom checked and unchecked icons displayed inside the thumb, loading state with spinner animation, size variants, render props for custom thumb content, label with optional description, validation states with error/success messages, and reduced motion support respecting prefers-reduced-motion. Works controlled (checked + onCheckedChange) or uncontrolled (defaultChecked). Do not use when multiple states are needed (use RadioButton or Select). Accessibility: role='switch', aria-checked boolean state, Space and Enter key toggle, Tab focus navigation, reduced motion respected. States: checked, unchecked, disabled, loading.

components.name: Table
components.text: Table is a feature-rich data grid built on TanStack Table v8 for displaying and interacting with tabular data. Use it for admin panels, analytics dashboards, data management interfaces, CRM systems, and any structured data display requiring interactivity. Features include column sorting (single and multi-column with shift-click), column filtering with custom filter UIs per column, row selection (single and multi with checkbox column), row expansion with nested content, column pinning (left and right sticky columns), column reordering via drag-and-drop, column resizing with drag handles, inline cell editing, infinite scroll pagination, row grouping with aggregation, CSV export via exportTableToCSV utility, clipboard copy via copyToClipboard, global search, responsive mobile card layout for small screens, shimmer loading state with configurable row count, empty state customization, and striped row styling. All utility functions are SSR safe. Do not use for simple static tabular data without interactivity — use plain HTML tables instead. Accessibility: standard table semantics (thead, tbody, tr, td), data-clickable/data-selected/data-striped attributes, keyboard navigation with ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Enter/Space/Tab. States: idle, loading, sorting, filtering, editing.

components.name: TabPanel
components.text: TabPanel organizes content into tabbed sections where only one panel is visible at a time, with a tab list for switching between panels. Use it for settings pages, dashboards, profile sections, content organization, and any interface requiring categorized views. Features include horizontal and vertical orientation, controlled (value + onTabChange) and uncontrolled (defaultValue) active tab, tooltips on tab buttons, custom tab rendering with render props, disabled individual tabs, closable tabs with onClose callback, lazy loading of panel content, badge display on tabs, icon support, and roving tabindex for keyboard navigation. Tab buttons use the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern with proper association between tabs and panels. Responsive design handles overflow with horizontal scrolling on the tab list. Accessibility: role='tablist' on list, role='tab' on buttons, role='tabpanel' on panels, aria-selected on active tab, aria-controls/aria-labelledby associations. Keyboard: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (horizontal) or ArrowUp/ArrowDown (vertical) to navigate, Home/End for first/last tab, loop option wraps navigation. States: idle, active, disabled.

components.name: TextArea
components.text: TextArea is a production-grade multi-line text input wrapping a native textarea element with comprehensive form features. Use it for comments, descriptions, messages, notes, feedback forms, and any multi-line content entry. Features include auto-resize that dynamically grows the textarea height as content is typed (minRows/maxRows configurable), clearable with X button, character count display with maxLength enforcement and visual warning near limit, start and end icon slots, validation states (error, success) with descriptive messages, description text, label association, and full ref forwarding. Works with native form attributes. Do not use for single-line input (use Input), select dropdowns (use Dropdown), or rich text editing (use a dedicated editor). Accessibility: label association via htmlFor/id, error/success messages linked via aria-describedby, standard form semantics, data-error/data-success attributes. States: idle, focused, disabled, error, success.

components.name: TimePicker
components.text: TimePicker allows users to select a time value using either a scrollable dropdown list of time options or an interactive analog clock face interface. Use it for scheduling, booking systems, alarm settings, event creation, and time-based form fields. Features include 12-hour (with AM/PM toggle) and 24-hour format support, configurable minute step intervals, min/max time constraints to limit selectable range, clearable value with X button, smart text parsing for typed input (e.g., '2pm' → '14:00'), and keyboard navigation through options. The clock variant provides an intuitive circular dial for hour selection followed by minute selection. Works controlled (value + onValueChange) or uncontrolled (defaultValue). Responsive sizing with w-full on mobile and w-56 on larger screens for the trigger, and adaptive clock face sizing. Accessibility: data-disabled/data-error/data-open attributes, data-selected/data-focused on dropdown options, arrow key navigation. States: idle, open, closed, disabled.

components.name: Toast
components.text: Toast is a notification system for displaying brief, transient messages that appear temporarily and auto-dismiss. It uses a Provider pattern with useToast() hook for imperative API — call toast.success(), toast.error(), toast.warning(), or toast.info() to show notifications. Use it for success confirmations, error alerts, operation feedback, warnings, and informational messages. Features include four types (success, error, warning, info) with distinct styling, configurable auto-dismiss duration, progress bar showing remaining time, pause-on-hover to halt auto-dismiss while user interacts, action buttons within the toast for inline responses, custom icons per type, position configuration (top/bottom with left/center/right alignment), maximum visible toast limit with queuing, and enter/exit CSS animations. Do not use for persistent alerts or critical messages requiring explicit user acknowledgment — use Modal instead. Accessibility: role='alert' with aria-live='assertive' for errors/warnings, role='status' with aria-live='polite' for success/info, aria-atomic='true', Escape key dismissal. States: entering, visible, exiting, removed.

components.name: Tooltip
components.text: Tooltip displays contextual information in a floating overlay when hovering over or focusing a trigger element. Use it for icon explanations, truncated text expansion, additional context on controls, abbreviated content clarification, and help text. Features include configurable placement (top, bottom, left, right with start/end alignment), arrow pointer to indicate trigger, shadow presets (none, sm, md, lg, xl) for visual depth, truncateOnly mode that only shows tooltip when text is actually truncated (prevents unnecessary tooltips on short text), configurable show/hide delays (delayDuration, hideDelayDuration), rich ReactNode content support, portal rendering to escape overflow containers, maxWidth constraint, and controlled/uncontrolled open state. Do not use for essential information that should always be visible, or interactive content that requires clicking — use Popover instead. Accessibility: role='tooltip', standard positioning via floating UI calculations, Escape key dismissal. States: idle, open, closed.
